## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run mypy reportnet_api` and `uv run pytest` pass
- [ ] Generated files were regenerated with their script, not edited by hand
- [ ] New behaviour has a mocked test; live-service claims are dated in `docs/live_testing_notes.md`
- [ ] README / reference updated if behaviour changed; a line added to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No tokens, API keys, real ids or personal data in code, tests or docs
